title: Stable influence bound by Boolean influence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. For $0\leq\rho\leq1$, the stable influence of the real-valued version of $f$ at $i$ is at most the Boolean influence of $f$ at $i$ raised to the power $2/(1+\rho)$.
